propositions: Operators cannot discover or configure the optional S3 backend because docs/config.md does not document sync.remote for s3:// remotes or name the git-remote-s3 dependency and SSE-KMS setup requirements

Documentation must cover S3 backend installation (pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]' with git-remote-s3>=0.3.2), SSE-KMS bucket/IAM/CMK configuration, git remote setup, AWS credentials trust boundary, and auto-doctor stale-lock self-heal behavior (60s TTL via GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS)

A new ADR 0093 must record the architectural choice to use git-remote-s3 below the git layer, accept SSE-KMS encryption, implement merge-based non-interactive auto-doctor, and reject lock TTL lowering
The ADR marker docs/adr/.numbers/0093 and regenerated docs/adr/README.md must be produced by scripts/gen_adr_index.py and pass bijection/cross-reference validation via scripts/check_adr_numbers.py
Both new documentation pages (docs/s3-backend.md and ADR 0093) must be discoverable via docs/README.md and the generated ADR index
